about_the_game:
Face the relentless onslaught of the Redgaze in Ash Warden, a fast-paced tower defense action game with a deep upgrade system and rich worldbuilding.
You play as the last guardian of the Seal Towers — mystical constructs holding back the Redgaze from breaching into the mortal realm. Across 11 increasingly intense levels, you must defend all three towers from destruction and uncover the forgotten truths behind your endless battle.

Gameplay

Each level pits you against relentless waves of enemies, culminating in a powerful boss fight. Aim and click to shoot enemies from above, or teleport instantly between towers to cover different attack lanes. Timing, positioning, and quick reactions are key to survival.

Defeating enemies grants Experience and Vestige. Leveling up awards Echoes, while bosses drop Sigils — each currency feeding into your skill tree.

  • Vestige + Echoes: Upgrade regular nodes to boost damage, speed, cooldowns, and other combat stats.

  • Sigils: Unlock entirely new skills and passives, enabling unique builds and strategies.

Progression & Builds

Choose between two core classes — Ranger or Melee — each with four distinct skill paths. Every run allows you to experiment with new combinations, adapting your build to the challenges ahead. The further you progress, the more powerful and personalized your playstyle becomes.

Lore Through Gameplay

Beyond the action, Ash Warden hides its story within weapons, skills, and relics. Every upgrade and artifact carries a fragment of the world’s history — piecing them together reveals the struggles, legends, and forgotten truths behind the war against the Redgaze.

Key Features

  • 11 handcrafted levels culminating in an epic final battle.

  • Fast-paced click-to-shoot combat with instant tower teleportation.

  • Dual-class skill tree with dozens of upgrades and unlockable abilities.

  • Boss battles that challenge both reflexes and strategy.

  • Lore discovery system hidden in gameplay elements.

  • Stylized dark-fantasy pixel art and atmospheric soundtrack.
